name: 25W USB-C Fast Charger
subtitle: Compact white wall charging adapter
description: This 25W USB-C fast charging power adapter features a single USB Type-C output and adaptive 5V and 9V profiles within its rated range. Its compact white design is intended for compatible smartphones, tablets, earbuds cases, power banks, and other USB-C accessories.
story: Designed as a compact everyday wall adapter, this charger fits naturally into home, office, and travel setups without adding unnecessary bulk. The single USB-C port keeps charging straightforward for one compatible device at a time. Its 25W maximum output can support faster charging where the connected device and cable support the required profile. The adapter accepts AC 100–240V input and includes stated protection against over-current, over-voltage, and excessive temperature during normal operation.
